function.name: run_sql
function.arguments:
{"sql":"SELECT pl.period, SUM(pl.qty * p.wholesale_price_cad) / SUM(pl.qty) AS weighted_avg_wholesale_price_cad
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line pl
JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.product p ON pl.sku = p.sku
WHERE pl.period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
GROUP BY pl.period","purpose":"Weighted average wholesale price of purchased SKUs per unit for Aug and Sep 2026"}
